AI, Agentic & Product Engineering Factory

Business Discovery & Transformation Advisory

Business problem discovery, value-chain assessment, As-Is and To-Be process analysis, AI opportunity identification, business case, ROI and transformation roadmap.

Process Architecture & Domain Engineering

Process mapping and BPMN, workflow design, process rationalisation, business requirements and domain-specific solution design.

AI, Agentic & Software Engineering

Generative AI applications, LLM and RAG solutions, AI agents and multi-agent systems, custom software, full-stack applications, APIs and human-in-the-loop solutions.

Data, Cloud & Enterprise Integration

Data pipelines and architecture, cloud engineering, ERP and CRM integration, enterprise APIs, legacy integration, identity and security architecture.

Product Engineering, Testing & QA

Product discovery, MVP and proof-of-concept development, functional and integration testing, AI evaluation, UAT, release management and quality assurance.

Deployment, DevOps & AI Operations

CI/CD, DevSecOps, MLOps, LLMOps, AgentOps, production monitoring, performance and cost optimisation, reliability and incident management.

Change Management & Business Adoption

Stakeholder alignment, change readiness, business–technology collaboration, user enablement, adoption measurement and benefits realisation.

Managed Services & Continuous Engineering

FormatiQs will provide ongoing engineering support to sustain solution performance and deepen client relationships.

  • Managed FDE teams
  • AI application support
  • Agent monitoring and optimisation
  • Model, prompt and workflow enhancements
  • Integration support
  • Platform maintenance
  • Product engineering extensions
  • Continuous testing and QA
  • Cloud and infrastructure optimisation
  • Operational performance management

The objective is to build recurring monthly and annual service relationships rather than depend exclusively on one-time implementation projects.

Target Customer Segments & Market Entry

Customer segmentTypical needs
Global enterprisesEnterprise AI deployment, process transformation, engineering capacity and managed services.
Technology & AI companiesFDE talent, engineering pods, implementation capacity and customer deployment support.
Startups & scaleupsProduct engineering, AI application development, MVPs, integrations and technical execution.
Universities & academic institutionsFDE curriculum, industry-aligned programmes, talent development, practical labs and industry collaboration.
MSMEs & mid-market businessesAffordable automation, AI adoption, process improvement and technology integration.

Initial market-entry focus should be technology companies, AI solution providers, selected global enterprises and universities with access to industry opportunities.

Potential pilot verticals include BFSI, manufacturing and supply chain, education, healthcare, retail and customer operations. These are market hypotheses to validate against client access and partner strength.
